text.description_html:
Acorn RUEBR, Heart Tip Rim Latch

Rim latches are great for adding old world beauty to your home. This one features a privacy locking function and a heart tip grip. It is made out of iron and is finished in a rough textured matte black finish for a historic look. The Heart Rim Latch for Interior and Exterior Doors is the perfect finishing touch for colonial building restoration projects as well as to add a touch of rustic beauty to any door. Reversible for right or left handing and comes with reverse bevel so it will work on doors that open in or out. Good for 7/8" to 1-3/4" door thicknesses.

Specifications: of the Heart Tip Rim Latch for Interior and Exterior Doors:

  • Passage door handle for hall side of door
  • Reverse bevel / closet door handle for room side or exterior of storm door
  • Includes all necessary hardware.
  • Field reservable.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Features of Rim Latch Set:

  • Handle Height: 8-1/2"
  • Handle Width: 1-5/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 7/8" to 1 3/4"

Sold as a set.
